ideas.pitch: An early warning web platform predicting water contamination and algal bloom risks for local water bodies in Uttarakhand using machine learning and IoT sensors.
ideas.problem_statement: Clean Water and Climate Action under UN SDGs
ideas.title: AquaPredict AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the UN Sustainable Development Goal for clean water with a predictive model proven successful in environmental hackathons.

ideas.pitch: Satellite-based remote sensing platform that monitors crop health, soil moisture, and drought stress indices to assist smallholder farmers in hilly regions.
ideas.problem_statement: Agriculture and Climate Action under UN SDGs
ideas.title: GeoAgro Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines satellite monitoring with actionable local agricultural advice, matching regional priorities for rural sustainability.

ideas.pitch: Edge-AI powered smart waste classification system designed for campus and smart city recycling bins using computer vision.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Cities and Climate Action under UN SDGs
ideas.title: EcoSort Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a hardware-software simulation demo that is visually impressive and easy for judges to understand immediately.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven diagnostic and triage copilot tailored for rural health workers in mountainous regions with limited connectivity.
ideas.title: HealthTract AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical regional healthcare delivery problem using lightweight offline-first machine learning models.

ideas.pitch: Predictive risk assessment model for regional forest fires using meteorological data and satellite vegetation indices.
ideas.title: WildfireWatch AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages geospatial data analytics to address ecological disasters highly relevant to Uttarakhand's geography.
